scenes.heading: Light that knocks electrons out
sentences: Shine light on a clean metal and electrons can leave it.
Brighter light does not help if the colour is wrong.

scenes.heading: A threshold and a straight line
sentences: A metal holds its electrons with a work function of 2.30 electron volts.
Light must reach 5.56e14 hertz before any electron comes out.
At 1e15 hertz each photon carries 4.14 electron volts.
The fastest electrons leave with 1.84 electron volts, and the line has the same slope for every metal.

scenes.heading: A second metal
sentences: A second metal holds its electrons more tightly, with a work function of 2.30 electron volts.
Its threshold moves right to 9.91e14 hertz, but its line is parallel to the first.

scenes.heading: Photons, not waves
sentences: The energy of a photon depends on the frequency alone.
That is why the colour decides, and the brightness only sets how many.
